h1: Custom Jersey T Shirts for Your Team
metaTitle: Custom Jersey T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom jersey t shirts for your team or event. Soft, breathable fabric perfect for screen printing. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Jersey fabric is a knit material known for its soft hand and natural stretch, making it a favorite for custom t shirts. Unlike standard cotton tees, jersey knits drape well and resist wrinkling, which is ideal for branded uniforms, event giveaways, or employee apparel. Whether you choose a fine jersey tee for a polished look or a performance blend for active wear, this fabric holds vibrant screen prints and embroidery cleanly. Bulk orders ensure consistent color and sizing across your entire team.
